Glance 2026.09.24 adds font and executable previews and expands command-line window control.

- Preview TrueType, OpenType, font collections, WOFF and WOFF2 with editable sample text, adjustable size and supported variable weight axes. Chinese samples include English text, and font metadata stays visible beside the preview.
- Inspect EXE and DLL files with overview, signatures, imports, exports, resources, .NET metadata and PE structure views. Search and sort entries, calculate SHA-256, copy reports and export resources without executing the inspected file.
- Use CLI `--quiet` to suppress stdout, including JSON error output on stderr when combined with `--json`. The CLI can run from a separate directory when Glance is already running.
- Target the main preview with `--id main`, activate windows with `window activate`, and toggle full-window presentation with `window fullwindow on|off`. Window results identify the main window and report text-loading completeness.
- Let structured JSON previews inherit the window backdrop and refresh update-frequency labels when changing the interface language.
- Consolidate component preview interfaces and correct keyboard activation for component-owned preview controls.
